candidates.rationale: Isovalent Sb for P expands tetrahedra like successful As to aid conductivity while staying charge-balanced.

risks: Electrochemical window v_low 2.0 V to v_high 2.3 V is narrow and electrodes_reduced_confidence true due to LiS4 polysulfide makes limits uncertain.
Interface_reaction_energy -0.150597 eV/atom with LiFePO4 indicates cathode reactivity, ranking near worst on mp-985583.

No Li vacancies (li_vacancies 0) plus sulfide moisture sensitivity limits expected conductivity, and E_hull per substitution 0.412 eV per modified site is worse than As analog -0.154 eV per modified site with Sb toxicity/cost concerns.

candidates.rationale: Dilute Se for S tests the low-dose limit of the hull-negative Se substitution to soften lattice for ion transport.

strengths: Thermodynamically stable with E_hull -0.00353 eV/atom and E_hull per substitution -0.113 eV per modified site with reduced_confidence false and ss_bonds false.
Electronically insulating with gap_optb88 2.594 eV above the 2.0 eV filter.
Passivating against Li metal with passivation_reaction_energy 2.306084 eV/atom and a defined window V_low 1.8 V to V_high 2.24 V (stable true).
risks: Electrochemical window 1.8 to 2.24 V does not include 0 V and electrodes_reduced_confidence true due to SeS7 in the window.

Se-substituted sulfide with li_vacancies 0 is moisture sensitive as typical for sulfides/selenides and may have low intrinsic Li carriers despite softer anion lattice.
analysis.summary: Se-doped Li12P4SeS15 is a stable, insulating and Li-passivating Li3PS4 derivative with a narrow low-confidence window and moderate cathode reactivity, warranting MD to test if Se softening alone enables Li diffusion in stoichiometric lattice.

candidates.rationale: Increase successful As doping to two sites to map solubility and framework tolerance for larger pnictogen.

strengths: Thermodynamically stable with E_hull -0.009578 eV/atom and E_hull per substitution -0.1532 eV per modified site, ranked lowest E_hull per atom on mp-985583 as Li6AsPS8 (it2-c3) -0.010 eV/atom.
Electronically insulating with gap_optb88 2.374 eV above 2.0 eV filter and ss_bonds false indicating no S-S dimers.
Passivating against Li metal producing Li2S/Li3AsS3/Li3PS4 and shows stable window 2.08-2.26 V with better stability than P->As on mp-641703 (Li7AsP2S11 0.024 eV/atom).
risks: Reduced_confidence true because stability and window go through polysulfides LiS4 and AsS2 where UMA is least reliable.
Narrow window 2.08-2.26 V requires SEI at Li-metal potential and interface reaction with LiFePO4 is -0.160895 eV/atom, worst on mp-985583 ranking.
As substitution brings toxicity and cost plus sulfide moisture sensitivity with oxidation to LiS4/AsS2 and potential H2S release.

control.summary: Li10GeP2S12 is reported as a lithium superionic conductor with a new three-dimensional framework structure in Nature Materials 10, 682–686 (2011). Single-crystal X-ray work describes tetragonal Li10GeP2S12 as the best solid Li ion conductor known, with structure previously determined from powder diffraction. It is widely available as LGPS powder solid-state electrolyte with very high Li+ ionic conductivity for lithium-ion battery research.

candidates.summary: Se has been introduced as an anion dopant for the Li7P3S11-type sulfide electrolyte to enhance conductivity and moisture stability, and SnSe2-doped 70Li2S-(30-x)P2S5-xSnSe2 glass-ceramic electrolytes based on Li7P3S11 have been prepared by ball-milling and annealing. In the Li-P-Se system, Li7PSe6 has been successfully synthesized in the argyrodite structure, while “Li3PSe4” was noted as unconfirmed experimentally. A computational review notes Li4P2Se6 and Li7PSe6 as reported phases and describes Li4PSe3 constructed by replacing S in Li3PS4 with Se. This search found no exact Li6P2SeS7 report.

candidates.label: close family already studied
candidates.summary: This search did not return the exact Li12P4SeS15 composition, but a computational phase-stability study lists Li3PSe4 as a predicted stable phase derived from ICSD-Li3PS4, the full-Se analogue of Se-substituted Li3PS4. Se-for-S anion doping in the closely related thiophosphate Li7P3S11 is reported experimentally as a series Li7P3S11-xSex (x=0-0.15), with Se substitution at S sites improving conductivity and moisture stability. The same Li3PS4 parent with a chemically similar anion dopant is reported as O-doped β-Li3PS4, e.g. Li3PS3.8O0.2 with ionic conductivity 1.13 mS cm-1 and suppressed H2S generation.
